item.snhunt.hunters_journal.tooltip: Right-click: Season 1 story. Sneak + right-click: monster lore.
block.snhunt.salt_line.tooltip: Place it as a line spirits and demons can't cross. Also shotgun ammo, and for salting graves.
item.snhunt.salt_shotgun.tooltip: Fires rock salt. Disperses spirits, stings everything else.
item.snhunt.emf_meter.tooltip: Hold it to sense spirits and haunted remains nearby.
item.snhunt.flare_gun.tooltip: Sets its target on fire. Wendigos hate it.
item.snhunt.holy_water.tooltip: Right-click to splash a demon within 8 blocks. It burns them.
item.snhunt.exorcism_rite.tooltip: Read it near a demon held in a Devil's Trap to cast it out.
block.snhunt.devils_trap.tooltip: Paint it on the floor. A demon that steps on it is stuck.
item.snhunt.machete.tooltip: Clean enough to take a vampire's head.
item.snhunt.dead_mans_blood.tooltip: Right-click a vampire: no healing, weak and slow for 30 seconds.
item.snhunt.the_colt.tooltip: A gun that can kill anything. Uses Colt Rounds.
item.snhunt.colt_round.tooltip: Ammunition for the Colt. Don't waste them.
block.snhunt.grave.tooltip: Salt it, then burn it. (Story block)
block.snhunt.cursed_object.tooltip: Break it to destroy whatever is bound to it. (Story block)
message.snhunt.no_colt_rounds: *click* The Colt is empty. You need Colt Rounds.
message.snhunt.blood_wasted: Dead man's blood only works on vampires.
message.snhunt.blood_poisoned: The vampire staggers. It can't heal now. Take its head!
message.snhunt.rite_success: Exorcizamus te... The demon is cast out!
message.snhunt.rite_greater: This demon is far too strong for the rite.
message.snhunt.rite_untrapped: The demon writhes but holds on. Trap it first!
message.snhunt.rite_nothing: You read the rite to an empty room.
message.snhunt.demon_fled: The demon pours out of its host as black smoke and escapes!
message.snhunt.grave_hint: Salt the bones (Rock Salt), then burn them (Flint and Steel).
message.snhunt.grave_hint_burn: Salted. Burn it with Flint and Steel or a Fire Charge.
message.snhunt.grave_burned: The bones go up in flames...
hint.snhunt.spirit: It passes right through you. Use iron or rock salt!
hint.snhunt.spirit_bound: It can't be killed like this. Salt and burn its remains!
hint.snhunt.wendigo: It barely felt that. Set it on fire first!
hint.snhunt.shapeshifter: Barely a scratch. Shapeshifters need silver!
hint.snhunt.demon: The host won't die. Trap the demon and exorcise it, or use holy water!
hint.snhunt.vampire: It keeps getting up. Only a beheading kills it: machete or axe!
hint.snhunt.shtriga: Only iron can hurt a shtriga!
hint.snhunt.daeva: It's strongest in the dark. Bring light!
hint.snhunt.scarecrow: It's bound to the sacred tree. Destroy the source of its power!
hint.snhunt.greater_demon: Nothing you've got can really hurt it. You need the Colt!
